children: Rick Bensignor, founder of Bensignor Investment Strategies, said the US 10-year Treasury yield could climb toward 6.07%, up from around 4.78% today. According to BeInCrypto, he cited a multi-year uptrend line and said even 5.6% would be a minimum upside target. Bitcoin did not exist the last time the 10-year traded near 6%, in April 2000, and Bensignor said higher yields could pressure BTC’s debasement trade narrative as the token trades near $80,138.

title: Rick Bensignor Sees US 10-Year Yield Climbing Toward 6.07%
